supplemental_items.interpretation: Price normalized Decimal(str), strict crossing only. No crossing => valid no consume. Interior gate excludes A winner; callbacks checked by None, index>0 and First present.

First stop exact and A First map to valid inclusive slice; choose first tied directional extreme. Head physical index must precede A; strict price then lazy Reaction bounds and confirmation strictly before source. Confirmation called only after index gates.
